senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָדַם) with רוּחַ, or sub. רוח, east wind. Mekh. B’shall. s. 4; Yalk. Jer. 300.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:2">Kel. XX, 2</cite> <he>הניחה … בק׳ וכ׳</he> if he exposed the trough to the east wind, and it cracked.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:8">Gitt. III, 8</cite> <he>בק׳ של מוצאי החג</he> (Bab. ed. 31ᵃ <he>בקדום</he>) after an east wind following the end of the Succoth festival; ib. 31ᵇ <he>בקִידּוּם</he>; a. e.
